summary.en: Bio-focused emerging VC founded June 2019 by Kim Do-hyun, former CFO/strategy head of botulinum-toxin maker Hugel. Closed a KRW 3.1bn first bio fund and was a 2024 Fund-of-Funds Rookie League GP investing in bio materials/components localization.
